Looking for that full-time job with training and growing opportunities? Work only in the day shift? Look no further! You found your  new job as a warehouse employee at Xenos in Waalwijk!
Sign up now and receive a WhatsApp message within 15 minutes with a few short questions so we can help you quickly. Don't have a WhatsApp? Then we'll contact you by phone or email!

What we offer
- Work in only day shifts
- Full-time work
- Salary of €14,99 per hour
- A friendly and cosy working atmosphere!
- Reimbursement of travel expenses
- Work in different departments

Who you are
To keep the warehouse running, it is important that you meet the following requirements as a warehouse employee:

- You have your own transport to go to Waalwijk.
- You speak Dutch or English.
- You can work in day shifts.
- You are available at least 2 days during the week.

What will you do
Sofas, chairs, confetti cannons, candles, cushions... Xenos has it all! As a warehouse employee, you’ll work among all this fun, colorful stuff. You work at the department for all of the products for the Xenos stores. You’re going to be driving around on an EPT to get all the different products! You put everything where it needs to go. You don’t need any prior experience, we’ll teach you everything!
This job is for the dayshifts only. You'll work from 07:00h until 16:00h. Awesome, right?!
Xenos pays different wages per age:

- 18 jaar: €7,50/hour
- 19 jaar: €8,99/hour
- 20 jaar: €11,99/hour
- 21+ jaar: €14,99/hour

Where will you work
You have probably already seen the Xenos stores! They are located all throughout the country! You will recognize Xenos by their fun, yellow logo 💛. Xenos has great products for your home. You will often see them in the warehouse! You will also get a great discount at the Xenos stores!
As a warehouse employee you will have great colleagues. You take breaks together and you are well supported by the team leaders. You’ll definitely feel welcome here!

Job application

Hey you! Looking for a fresh challenge in logistics? Great news! Arvato in Heijen is hiring new orderpickers. You’ll be working in a 2-shift system (sometimes day shifts are available too), earning €14.99 per hour. On top of that, you get a 19% shift allowance for evening shifts after 7 PM. And last but not least? You get paid every week! #KA-CHING Keep reading, I’ll tell you all about what this role has to offer!

What we offer
- Starting salary from €14.99 per hour
- More experience means higher pay!
- Guaranteed 32 hours per week
- 19% shift allowance after 7 pm of €17,84
- Travel allowance and holiday pay
- Permanent hire possible with good performance

Who you are
As a warehouse worker, it’s important that you meet the following requirements:

- You speak English
- You are available immediately
- You can work at least 4 days a week
- You are able to work in a 2-shift system (06:00 - 15:00 / 15:00 - 00:00)

Your tasks include picking orders, carefully packing items, and performing quality checks. You’ll work across various departments, each handling its own unique products. During breaks, you can enjoy a nice cup of coffee or a cold drink, plus tasty sandwiches and soups from our well-stocked cafeteria.

Where will you work
Arvato in Heijen is a large logistics company well known in the region. Our facility is easily accessible and offers a dynamic work environment where every day brings something new. Teamwork is at the heart of what we do. With multiple departments handling different tasks, your work stays varied and interesting. Whether you’re picking orders, packing products, or checking quality, you’ll always have something new to do. Working here isn’t just challenging—it’s enjoyable! You’ll join a friendly, enthusiastic group of colleagues. We care about your growth

You already have experience in engineering and would like to develop your skills further in this field. At DSV in Breda, you can! In return for a salary of €15.55 per hour, you’ll work as a technical operator to ensure that all industrial installations keep running smoothly. Want to start soon? Apply today!

Your responsibilities

In this role, you’ll be responsible for operating, monitoring and maintaining industrial machinery and systems. This means you’ll ensure the equipment keeps running, quickly resolve any faults and carry out preventative maintenance. You’ll work closely with the lead technician and other colleagues, and your tasks will include:

    - Replacing sensors and simple machine parts
    
- Carrying out preventative maintenance
    
- Assisting with work on pneumatic, mechanical and electrical systems
    
- Recording maintenance and fault-repair work
    
- Working in accordance with safety and quality guidelines

What’s in it for you

    - Gross hourly wage of €15.55
    
- Travel allowance
    
- Part-time or full-time role between 32 and 37.5 hours per week
    
- Temporary contract via Manpower with the possibility of a permanent contract with DSV
    
- Development opportunities via Manpower Academy (over 200 online training courses)
    
- Pension scheme via Manpower
    
- Opportunities for personal development within a technical working environment

To carry out this role effectively, you will need the following:

    - Experience as an operator, machine operator, maintenance engineer or in a similar technical role
    
- Technical understanding and a hands-on approach 
    
- Experience of carrying out basic maintenance tasks
    
- A good command of English, for communication on the shop floor
    
- Experience with Microsoft Excel, Word and Outlook 

In addition, it would be an advantage, though not essential, if you also have the following:

    - Knowledge of sensors, pneumatics, motors or drives
    
- A forklift licence

In this role, you will be part of a close-knit and hardworking team. Together with your colleagues, you will ensure that all tasks are carried out as efficiently as possible so that the workday can be completed together.

As a Supply Chain Order Picker, you will work with your own picking trolley equipped with crates in which you collect customer orders. Once the crates are filled, you will place them on a conveyor belt, where they are automatically transported to the next department. You will use a handheld scanner in combination with a voice-picking system. For this position, it’s important that you have basic computer skills, as you will also need to process certain warehouse tasks in the system. During a comprehensive training session on your first working day, you will learn how to use this system.

Most of your work will take place in the warehouse, where you will collect products. Some of these products are stored in refrigerated or freezer areas. You will be provided with a warm jacket for working in these areas. After collecting the required products, you will return to the main warehouse.

The working days are Monday to Friday. (shift starts between 08:00 a.m. and 8:30 a.m. to 5:00 or 04:30 p.m.)

- Minimum of vmbo-level work and thinking skills
- One to two years of experience in a similar role
- Good command of the English language
- Willingness to work in a team and be flexible with shifts
